acceptance: Per flakes:IMP-064 and IMP-060: .envrc uses use_dev_envs and the local jail and form family goes, so a consumer of the overlay does not inherit agents or quotient. Compare the family against dev-envs before deleting. `quotient allow` is the operator's act.
notes: 2026-11-05. .envrc is ignored by the global gitignore, so it is machine-local and no commit carries it. Family compared against dev-envs: git, bash, findutils, gnugrep, gnused, gawk, ripgrep, fd are on the form base PATH; socat and codex dropped, used by nothing here; zmx was missing from dev-tools and is now in it, guarded by checks.dev-tools-ship-wrapper; workspaceDeps ~/flakes moved to JAIL_WORKSPACE_DEPS in .envrc. dev-tools builds to the same store path locally and through dev-envs, so the project keeps its pins. dev-envs checks.project-pins cannot run here: it reads nixpkgsRev, which only the stub sets. Forms relinked with ~/flakes/bin/dev-envs-forms; quotient allow remains the operator's. DL_ZMX_ELISP now reaches only the fallback devshell; nothing reads it, and tk-elisp-cutover deletes it.
title: Move to dev-envs and slim the flake
